frontmatter.name: litert-runtime
frontmatter.description: Configures and implements LiteRT (.tflite) on-device inference on Android in Kotlin using the CompiledModel API on CPU and GPU. Use this skill for any Android LiteRT or .tflite task, including Gradle setup, image classification or vision/audio/embedding helpers, TensorBuffer reuse, CPU memory optimization, Bitmap preprocessing, AndroidViewModel GPU-to-CPU fallback with warm-up on a single-thread dispatcher, LiteRT in Google Play services (play-services-litert), migrating from legacy org.tensorflow.lite.Inte

nodes.label: Step 1: Configure Gradle and place the model file
Step 2: Implement the inference helper class
Step 3: Wire the ViewModel and Compose screen
Step 4: Preprocess inputs to match the model contract
Step 5: Verify output on a physical device
